fuente: muse schema generate-json-schema --out DIR (Muse Code 1.4.10, superficie estable). El binario trae el esquema: es exacto para esa versión.
nota: Es el protocolo de `muse serve` (MSP, camelCase). Lo que `muse exec --json` imprime son registros duraderos en snake_case (ver exec-json-echo.jsonl); el campo `allowance` de `run.usage` y el objeto de fallo de `run.terminal.failed` NO están en este esquema: se ven con una llamada real.

UsageReadResult.description:
`usage/read` result: `{usage?}` — omitted, never `null`, when the host
has observed nothing (ADR 32563 D2: truthful absence, no
"nothing observed" error).

usage.description: The last-observed subscription usage window, when one exists.

SubscriptionUsage.description:
The one usage payload shape: the `usage/read` result's `usage` member and
the `usage/changed` params (ADR 32563 D2/D3). The numbers are
point-in-time — `observedAtMs` is the host's arrival stamp, so a client
renders "as of", never implies live data (spec 18742 US-FR-004).

observedAtMs.description:
When the host RECEIVED this observation (frame arrival or mint
request-send), epoch milliseconds.

tier.description: The provider's subscription tier id, verbatim.

SubscriptionUsageWindow.description:
The current usage window (the provider's 5-hour-class block): verbatim
provider percentages with the reset stamp normalized to epoch
milliseconds (ADR 32563 D2).

resetsAtMs.description: When the window resets, epoch milliseconds.

usedPercent.description:
Percent of the window's budget used: an integer ≥ 0, verbatim from
the provider — over-quota values above 100 are valid.

SubscriptionUsageWeekly.description:
The rolling weekly block: same semantics as
[`SubscriptionUsageWindow`] without a duration (ADR 32563 D2).

resetsAtMs.description: When the weekly window resets, epoch milliseconds.

usedPercent.description: Percent of the weekly budget used (integer ≥ 0, may exceed 100).

QuotaDetail.description:
Typed quota-exhaustion detail (tdd SS4.5.1, ADR 50047 D2): the limit
kind plus the provider's reset instant.

limitKind.description: Which quota was exhausted (open enum; unknown values fall back).

resetsAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds at which the provider says usage resets.

LimitKind.description: Quota limit kinds (tdd SS4.5.1, ADR 50047 D2): open for evolution.

TurnError.description:
The settled turn-failure object (tdd SS4.5.1): `{kind, message,
retryable}`.

kind.description:
The failure class (open camelCase enum grounded in the runtime's
terminal failure classification).

quota.description:
Typed quota-exhaustion detail (ADR 50047 D2/D3): present iff the
stopping failure was the quota class. Clients branch on presence,
never by parsing `message`.

retryable.description: The server's judgment that resubmitting the same input may succeed.

TurnErrorKind.description:
Turn failure classes (tdd SS4.5.1, `TerminalErrorKind` plus the
model-task failure class). Open.

TurnTerminal.description:
Turn terminal vocabulary (tdd SS4.5.1): exactly the runtime's
`RunTerminalKind` — closed in the runtime, wire-open for evolution.

ModelListParams.description:
`model/list` params (tdd SS3.10): the discovery half of the model-picker
gesture. **A query, not a command** — no `commandId`, no durable intake
record, no view event.

sessionId.description:
When present, the row matching that session's effective model is
flagged `isActive`. When absent, no row is active — a client may list
before it has a session (tdd SS3.10).

ModelListResult.description:
`model/list` result (tdd SS3.10). A snapshot at call time: v1 has no
catalog subscription. `models` MAY be empty — a build shipped with no
bundled models is a supported configuration.

source.description:
Where the catalog came from — how a client tells a live provider
catalog from a test fake and labels it honestly.

ModelCatalogEntry.description:
One visible catalog row (tdd SS3.10). Catalog rows marked hidden never
reach the wire, so a client cannot select one.

contextLimit.description: Context limit; `null` when the catalog source declared nothing.

cost.description: Cost block; `null` when the catalog source declared nothing.

defaultReasoningEffort.description:
The row's catalog default. Optional only for decoding older hosts; a
present value is never null and is always a member of `variants`.
Absent under `"unknown"` (ADR 33400 D2).

description.description: Description; `null` when the catalog source declared nothing.

isActive.description:
Marks the session's effective model when `sessionId` was supplied. May
be false for every row — a client MUST NOT assume exactly one.

isDefault.description: Marks the catalog's default row. May be false for every row.

outputLimit.description: Output limit; `null` when the catalog source declared nothing.

profileId.description: Provider profile; `null` when the catalog source declared nothing.

reasoningEffortVariants.description:
Described selectable tiers, a same-order subset of `variants`.
Optional only for decoding older hosts; a present value is never
null. Absent under `"unknown"` (ADR 33400 D2).

releaseDate.description: Release date; `null` when the catalog source declared nothing.

variants.description:
Complete ordered selectable efforts. Optional only for decoding older
hosts; a present value is never null. Current hosts always send it.

ModelCatalogSource.description:
Where a model catalog came from (tdd SS3.10). **Open**: an unrecognized
value is an unknown source, not an error.

ReasoningEffort.description:
The reasoning-effort tier sampled at submission (tdd SS3.2, SS3.3). The
**same closed tier vocabulary** on both the fresh-turn and steer lanes,
spelled identically; invalid tiers are invalid params. `none` is a tier of
the vocabulary (ask for no reasoning), not a way to say "unset".

CumulativeCost.description:
Server-computed session cost member of [`CumulativeTokenUsage`]
(tdd SS4.6.5, Amendment #41610 FR-41610-2/3).

partial.description:
True when at least one leg lacked price data — clients render
`(partial)`.

usd.description: Estimated USD total, finite and non-negative.

CumulativeTokenUsage.description:
Session running totals of counted-once usage (tdd SS4.6.5).

Amendment #41610: the cache splits and server-computed `cost` join the
counters. The counters stay accumulate-only; `cost` is the documented
exception — it may move either way on price re-adoption and is labeled
estimate (INV-41610-1). `Copy` was dropped for the `cost` member.

cacheReadTokens.description:
Cache-read tokens, session total (FR-41610-1): saturating sum of
the per-completion splits; an absent split contributes 0.
Additive-optional: absent on the wire reads as 0 and zero totals
are omitted, so pre-feature bytes decode and re-encode identically.

cacheWriteTokens.description:
Cache-write tokens, session total (FR-41610-1). Additive-optional
like the read split.

cost.description:
Server-computed session cost (FR-41610-2): `None` (wire-absent)
when no leg is priced — clients omit the row. Additive-optional:
absent reads as unpriced.

ModelCost.description:
Per-1M-token catalog cost, carried **verbatim** for display and never
rounded or re-formatted by the host (tdd SS3.10). Cost arithmetic stays
client-local view math.

currency.description: Currency; nullable — today's catalogs are USD.

TokenUsage.description:
Raw token counters, verbatim from the durable record (tdd SS4.6.5, the
runtime's `Usage`, camelCased). Not directly summable across providers —
sum the counted-once derivations instead (#8803).

cacheReadTokens.description: Cache read tokens, only when the provider distinguishes writes/reads.

cacheWriteTokens.description:
Cache write tokens, only when the provider distinguishes
writes/reads.

cachedTokens.description:
Provider-reported cache tokens (inside or beside `inputTokens`,
provider-convention-dependent — the reason `promptTokens` exists).

reasoningTokens.description: Output tokens spent on reasoning, when the provider reports it.

ContextUsage.description:
The SS4.9.1 snapshot `contextUsage` block: the latest
`(windowTokens, usedTokens, pressure)` triple; the snapshot member is
`null` until the fold's generation chain holds a tracked anchor AND the
current basis is present (absent is never fabricated).

usedTokens.description: Counted-once occupancy at the latest provider-reported fact.

windowTokens.description: The effective context-window size; absent when the basis has no limit.
